subject: Post-call: proposal to establish a rotating calendar relay for technical deep-dive
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Kim <oliver.kim@aerocloud.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 23:12:00 -0700 (PDT)
Subject: Post-call: proposal to establish a rotating calendar relay for technical deep-dive

Hi Oliver / Jin —

Thanks again for a great discovery call today. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can lock the deep-dive: 

Recap (30-minute discovery)
- Primary objective: evaluate Redwood Inference for production LLM inference (latency/cost SLA, private deployment options).
- Key stakeholders: Oliver (Platform), Jin (SRE), occasional attendance: APAC infra lead and security reviewer.
- Open questions: data retention/KMS options, quantization/perf profile for our 32k-token baseline, expected concurrency patterns.

Proposed next step: 60-minute technical deep-dive + infra review where our Solutions Engineer (Ava) walks through architecture, perf tradeoffs, and a short sandbox demo. Given the global team, Oliver suggested rotating meeting times so burden rotates across regions.

Suggested rotating cadence (proposal)
- Week 1 (US-friendly): Tue 15:00–16:00 PT / 22:00–23:00 UTC (works best for Marcus/Ava + AeroCloud US)
- Week 2 (EU-friendly): Wed 14:00–15:00 UTC / 15:00–16:00 CET (better for AeroCloud EU)
- Week 3 (APAC-friendly): Thu 08:00–09:00 HKT / 00:00–01:00 UTC (APAC morning)

Why rotate: spreads the primary meeting inconvenience across AeroCloud / Redwood teams, makes recurring attendance realistic for cross-regional stakeholders, and ensures sessions include the correct on-call SRE for deeper infra dives.

Options to finalize timing:
- If you prefer, pick a single weekly window from my Calendly (link below) and we’ll rotate invites internally per the pattern above.
- Or, confirm preferred baseline timezone pattern and I’ll circulate a recurring invite that alternates weekly.

Action items for AeroCloud
- Confirm whether the rotating pattern above is workable for your core three stakeholders.
- Confirm who should be on the invite as mandatory (SRE, Security, Product).

I attached a short post-call notes PDF and a tentative .ics with the three-week rotation so you can see how it looks in calendar. If that looks good I’ll have Ava build a 60-min agenda and include a short perf checklist for your SREs.

Thanks — I’ll follow-up on the calendar once I hear your preferred pattern.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0187
https://redwood.com

Attachment: post-call-notes.pdf (summary, key questions)
Attachment: calendar-relay-proposal.ics (preview of rotating schedule)
From: Oliver Kim <oliver.kim@aerocloud.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Jin Park <jin.park@aerocloud.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 07:05:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: proposal to establish a rotating calendar relay for technical deep-dive

Marcus —

Appreciate the clear recap and the .ics preview. The approach makes sense and we’d like to trial the rotating relay pattern. Our suggested slight modification: align the 3-week rotation to start with an EU-friendly slot (so our EU PM can attend week 1 in full). Proposed pattern: 

- Week A (EU): Tue 14:00–15:00 UTC (15:00 CET) — preferred first session
- Week B (US): Wed 16:00–17:00 UTC (09:00 PT)
- Week C (APAC): Thu 00:00–01:00 UTC (08:00 HKT)

We can commit to having Jin (SRE) join every session; APAC infra lead will attend Week C as available. Please make the invites optional for APAC so follow-ups don’t block calendars.

Two asks from our side before the deep-dive: 
1) Can Ava include a 10-minute segment on KV cache behavior and a 15-minute slot to review expected throughput with 4x V100s (our test baseline)?
2) We’ll send a short SOC2 evidence checklist to your security contact — can you confirm who to direct that to?

I’m adding our Calendly link for cross-checking availability: https://calendly.com/oliver-aerocloud/meet. If you can send a tentative invite matching Week A next Tue, we’ll accept and make internal adjustments.

Thanks — Oliver
Oliver Kim
Head of Platform | AeroCloud, Inc.
oliver.kim@aerocloud.com | +44 20 7946 0921
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Kim <oliver.kim@aerocloud.com>, Jin Park <jin.park@aerocloud.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 10:08:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: proposal to establish a rotating calendar relay for technical deep-dive

Thanks Oliver — that modification works for us. I’ll assemble the recurring invite and mark the weeks as Week A (EU), Week B (US), Week C (APAC) per your order. Key callouts before I send invites: 

- Agenda (60 min): 5m intro, 10m infra context (AeroCloud), 10m KV cache & perf (Ava), 20m demo + perf run-through (Ava + Marcus), 10m Q&A/action items.
- Ava will prepare the 10-minute KV cache doc and a short throughput table for the 4xV100 baseline — attaching to the invite.
- Security contact: please send the SOC2 evidence checklist to security@redwood.com. Our Security Ops lead (Katherine Hsu) will triage and coordinate.

I’ve created a tentative recurring Zoom invite (link in related_links) with the first session set to next Tue at 14:00 UTC (Week A). The invite will mark the APAC participants as optional for Week C and include an alternate time for any conflicts. I’m including the .ics preview in this thread for your admin team.

Action items assigned
- AeroCloud: confirm mandatory attendees for all sessions (we have Jin as mandatory already).
- Redwood (Ava): prepare KV cache + throughput 1-pager; attach to invite.
- Redwood (Marcus): finalize attendee list and send recurring invite once AeroCloud confirms.

Sending the invite now as tentative — please accept if the Week A timing is good and we’ll mark the recurrence live.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com

Attachment: calendar-relay-proposal.ics (tentative recurring invite)
